en: Look! I have a tiny seed. What will it become?
Listen! <SAW> taught us: when a Muslim plants a tree, and a bird, a person or an animal eats from it, it counts as a charity for him!
So let's plant! Dig a little hole, drop in the seed, and cover it up.
Splash, splash! We give it water every day.
Wow! It grew into a big tree, full of apples!
A little bird eats one. Tweet tweet! A hungry goat eats one too. Every bite is a good deed for the one who planted it!
What can you plant this week? Ask your grown-up!
